html:
News Digest:

Total assets committed by individual investors to private equity will grow 2.4 times from presently to $1.2 trillion by 2025, a recently released report co-authored by Boston Consulting Group and iCapital has forecast.

 

Takeaway:

High net worth individuals (HNWIs) will represent over 10% of all funds raised by private equity funds by then, boosting their allocations at a compound annual growth rate of 19%, the report forecasts.

 

 

End Notes
Source: https://www.privateequitywire.co.uk/2022/03/01/312516/investment-private-equity-reach-usd12tn-2025
